_note: Your brand. Run /setup-brand in Claude Code to fill this in interactively, or edit by hand. Hex values only.
name: Your Name

semantic._use: red=like/subscribe/stop/mistakes, green=money/success, amber=warnings/tips, purple=AI/magic moments. primary stays the default.

fonts.heading: Inter
fonts._source: Google Fonts names, so the composition can load them. headingWeights: brand = wordmark weight, headline = big slide headline weight.

faceSafeZones._note: Where your face sits, as % of frame (x,y = top-left corner). Overlays avoid this box. /setup-brand can measure it from a sample clip.

corner._note: webcam bubble bottom-right in screen tutorials

motion.style: Subtle and premium. Occasional 1-3 word keyword highlights, soft slide up + fade + light blur-in, quick fade out. Mostly no text on screen. No captions, bounces, spins, or rainbow effects.

endCard.headline: Subscribe for more
endCard._note: subline null = show channel.handle if set, otherwise nothing.

stitch._note: soft crossfade between clips; 0 for hard cuts

channel.name: Your Name
channel._note: Wordmark shown on slides and the end card. handle (e.g. "@yourchannel") shows on the end card; null hides it.
